description: Invoke a Lambda function and return its response.

function_name.description: The name or ARN of the Lambda function to invoke.

invocation_type.description: Optional invocation type, sent as X-Amz-Invocation-Type, such as RequestResponse or Event.

log_type.description: Optional log type, sent as X-Amz-Log-Type, such as Tail to include execution logs.

payload.description: Optional payload string sent as the invocation request body.

qualifier.description: Optional version or alias qualifier selecting which published version to invoke.

name: invoke_function
